In this prophetic message, the Senior Pastor reveals the processes by which God positions us for lifting into abundance, relevance and generational impact.

Listen. Share. Be transformed.
title: God’s Call for Your Lifting 2

text:
When God created man, He blessed him with dominion and all he needs to reign in life. One of the components of this blessing is the power of multiplication that causes man to increase, expand, and ultimately take over. 

In this message, "The Multiplying Effect of God's Blessings," Pastor Tara expounds on the virtues God has equipped us with to take over our spheres of influence, subdue opposing forces and fully step into our God-ordained mandate of dominion.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: The Multiplying Effect of God's Blessings.mp3
title: The Multiplying Effect of God's Blessings

text:
Prosperity is God's certain will for the believer and it is enjoyed only when we understand that it is a supernatural act that involves our participation. Everywhere we see people prospering in the scriptures, we see a mighty display of God's power but we also see instructions being given to men.

In this message, "How To Engage Faith for Prosperity", Pastor Tara Akinkuade underscores that true faith isn't passive but manifests through corresponding actions. He shows us how through the channels of light, wisdom, courage and prayer, we engage our faith to enjoy prosperity.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: How to Engage Faith for Supernatural Prosperity.mp3
title: How to Engage Faith for Supernatural Prosperity

text:
Throughout the Bible, we see how God lifted people like David and Esther into places of honour and authority, positioning them to influence nations according to His will. This is still God's desire for us today — to plant us in positions of power to dominate sectors, influence decisions, and establish His will on the earth.

In this powerful message, "Dominating Over Cities," Pastor Tara unveils how God strategically places us in positions of authority, and reveals three profound ways God empowers us to take dominion and fulfill His divine agenda in the places He positions us.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Dominating Over Cities

text:
God has empowered every believer to take over places and influence systems on earth for His glory.

In this message, "Taking Over Territories," Pastor Tara outlines principles from God's word to help us step into influence and authority, thereby enabling us to take over places and sectors for God. He also establishes the importance of seeking God's kingdom first in carrying out this divine mandate.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Taking Over Territories B

text:
God's grace has already positioned us to take lands and exercise dominion over places. To experience this vitally, we must grow beyond our limitations and enlarge our heart with His word.

In this message, "Dominating Through Largeness", Pastor Tara unveils key principles we must embrace to rise and take dominion. He reveals how to interact with God's word for wisdom and how to activate God's power for our supernatural elevation.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Dominating through Largeness

text:
God's word contains the power to transform any life, break any bondage, heal any disease and deliver great victories to anyone who will receive it. To receive and enjoy all of these and the many other benefits encapsulated in God's word, it is important to receive the word of God with an open heart.

In this powerful message preached by Pastor Tara Akinkuade, he unveils truths from God's word that will help you experience victories in life, infuse in you the strength to rise above any situation and break any barrier hindering you from experiencing the goodness of God.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Harvest of Miracles

In this powerful message, Pastor unveils truths from God's word that will help you experience victories in life, infuse in you the strength to rise above any situation and break any barrier hindering you from experiencing the goodness of God.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Impartation The Key to Manifestation

text:
The believer has been called to a life of victory. However, sometimes, he is faced with situations that are completely contrary to God's promises for him. Through supernatural tools of destiny, these situations can be constantly surmounted thereby causing the believer to enjoy God's best for him.

In this powerful message, "Birthing Real Miracles", the Senior Pastor expounds on revelational light as a vital tool in the believer's experience of continuous victory and miracles in the face of opposing circumstances.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Birthing Real Miracles

The believer has been called to a life of victory. However, sometimes, he is faced with situations that are completely contrary to God's promises for him. Through supernatural tools of destiny, these situations can be constantly surmounted thereby causing the believer to enjoy God's best for him.

In this powerful message, "Birthing Real Miracles", the Senior Pastor expounds on revelational light as a vital tool in the believer's experience of continuous victory and miracles in the face of opposing circumstances.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Birthing Real Miracles 2

text:
There are times when people feel weighed down by life's challenges — stagnation, shame, sickness, lack, or failure. God's answer in such instances is usually men He has raised for the liberation of a generation and the acceleration of results in the lives of men. Freedom and lifting in life come by recognizing and honouring these men He has sent.

In this message, "The Lifting of Your Head," Pastor Tara reveals how God works through anointed men to break limitations and remove stagnation. He teaches that progress should be continuous and highlights the importance of honouring God's anointed in experiencing breakthroughs. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: The Lifting of Your Head

text:
Righteousness is a gift that cannot be worked for; it is gotten by faith in the finished works of Jesus Christ. God's word shows us all that believers begin to enjoy access to when we submit to the righteousness of God. 

In this message, "The Findings of Righteousness," Pastor Tara highlights, using Proverbs 21:21, some of these benefits we have when we put our faith in Christ Jesus and the righteousness God gives us as a result — life, righteousness and honour.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: The Findings of Righteousness B

text:
God's power is always available to heal and ensure we experience divine health the way God intended. Hence, no matter how long sickness has lingered in our bodies, rather than being accustomed to it, we should believe, yearn for and release God's power for our healing - just like the woman with the 12-year blood disease who touched the hem of Jesus' garment and was instantly healed (Matthew 9:20 - 22). 

In this powerful message, "Releasing the Power of God to Heal," Pastor Tara reveals three transformative ways to activate and release God's power for our healing. These ways not only deliver us from the shackles of sickness but also cause us to live a life of lasting, divine health.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: Releasing the Power of God to Heal B.mp3
title: Releasing the Power of God to Heal B

text:
God purposes that as believers, we experience continuous progress and increase in every area of our lives. Part of ensuring that this becomes our reality is silencing and ascending beyond limiting voices that try to hold us back from experiencing life the way God desires.

In this power-packed message, "Ascents: Silencing Lying Lips," Pastor Tara reveals five sources through which these limiting voices can arise and empowers us with powerful ways of overcoming them for our victory in life. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Ascents Silencing Lying Lips

text:
The believer, by redemption, has been qualified to enjoy a life of perpetual advancement. Enjoying this, however, requires us to pray for the peace of the nation in which we dwell, because the state of our nation influences the manifestation of God's promises in our lives. 

In this fourth part of the series on Ascents, "Ascents: The Peace of Nations," Pastor Tara emphasizes how national peace fuels personal progress. He unpacks how consistent, spirit-filled prayer releases divine peace over our nation, thereby positioning us for divine ascent.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Ascents; The Peace of Nations

text:
One indisputable blessing that God gave man was the right of ownership. As believers, we are carriers of this blessing; therefore, we are ordained to own, possess, and dominate territories for the advancement of God's Kingdom. However, it takes intentional response to fully walk in it.

In this enlightening and power-packed message, "Rising into Ownership," Pastor Tara unveils three prophetic ways to lay hold of this blessing that causes us to not only advance God's Kingdom but to also experience undeniable prosperity and influence on the earth.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Rising into Ownership

text:
God's desire for believers is not mere survival. It is to overflow with wealth that serves His purposes on earth. However, to experience wealth in this dimension, there are certain limitations and barriers that God shatters — should they exist in our lives 

In this power-packed message, "Accessing the Wealth of Nations," Pastor Tara unveils three critical things God must break to unlock a free flow of divine wealth. When these are broken, wealth begins to respond, flow, and multiply into our hands for kingdom impact.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Accessing the Wealth of Nations

text:
By redemption, we are qualified to experience perpetual advancement in life. This encompasses triumphing over the contempt of the proud who are determined to keep us small, suppress our ambitions, and crush our urge to ascend on earth.

In this powerful sermon, "Ascents: Mercy for the Contempt of the Proud," Pastor Tara reveals how we can confront and judge these forces that try to hinder us with boldness and divine power. He teaches us that continuous, spirit-filled prayer is the key that activates God's power to cripple the contempt that hinders our progress and opens the way for steady advancement.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: Ascents; Mercy for the Contempt of the Proud.mp3
title: Ascents; Mercy for the Contempt of the Proud

text:
God's predestined plan for us is not for us  to lay hold on blessings solely through our efforts. He has made a way through inheritance. Yet, while inheritance can be released by impartation, it is activated and multiplied through obedience to instruction.

In this revelatory message, "Instructions of Inheritance," Pastor Tara emphasizes on how our response to divine instructions that follows impartation determines the speed and scale of our results. He outlines three simple yet powerful instructions that, when acted upon, cause impartation to produce visible and undeniable results. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Instructions of Inheritance B

text:
Spiritual encounters are divine deposits, designed to shift a man's direction, fuel purpose, and birth undeniable results in life. However, many people lose the potency of their encounters because they fail to hold fast to them and act on them intentionally.

In this deeply enlightening message, "Holding Your Encounters Fast," Pastor Tara teaches how to maximise your encounters and move from experience to manifestation. He further expounded on three powerful ways to preserve your encounters with actionable steps to continually get lasting results from them.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Holding Your Encounters Fast

text:
God's manifold grace which is expressed as unmerited favour and supernatural ability is the true power behind great prosperity. However, to enjoy this grace, it has to be activated and stewarded by utterance.

In this transformational message, "The Utterances of God," Pastor Tara makes us understand that speaking is a great spiritual tool for birthing divine possibilities. Through intentional, positive, spirit-filled and continuous conversations aligned with God's Word, we can call forth provision, dominion, and other mighty results.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: The Utterances of God 2

text:
Every believer has been destined for a life of victory and success in Christ. However, to fully walk in this reality, our minds must conceive this possibility as it is the birthplace of pictures, and pictures play a vital  role in the miracles we experience.

In this deeply prophetic message, "Pondering to Profit," Pastor Tara unveils how activating our imagination is the gateway to receiving the supernatural. He walks us through three practical ways to stir our imagination, align it with God's promises, and birth God-sized realities in our life, enabling us to produce and multiply miracles effortlessly. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed
title: Pondering to Profit

text:
God desires that His divine agendas — which are revealed through personal revelation, the voice of His anointed, and insights from the Scriptures — are established on the earth through us. For these divine agendas to manifest, they must be birthed and sustained through consistent and earnest prayer.

In this deeply prophetic message, "Praying Out Divine Agenda," Pastor Tara unveils the power of prevailing prayer in birthing what God has purposed. He shares three transforming encounters that take place in extended times of prayer and move divine agendas from revelation to full manifestation.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Praying Out Divine Agenda

text:
When Jesus ascended into heaven, He gave us men as gifts. These anointed men carry graces that have the power to accelerate results in our lives. It is therefore our responsibility to recognise, receive and maximize the graces on the men God has given to us as gifts for our lifting. 

In this powerful message,"Maximizing Graces," Pastor Tara emphasizes that unprecedented breakthroughs happen when we don't just connect to God's anointed but when we actively have faith in the graces they carry. He reveals three powerful ways to express that faith so that we can experience consistent, effortless, and multiplied breakthroughs.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Maximizing Graces B

text:
Having faith for our healing is having an unshaken assurance in what God says about our health in the Bible, even when symptoms persist. It is with this unshaken assurance that we experience healing from sickness in all its forms. 

In this life-changing message, "Faith for Healing," Pastor Tara unveils how to rightly position our faith  not just to receive healing, but to walk in lasting, divine health. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed
title: Faith for Healing B

text:
Encounters are heaven's visitations designed to shift the course of our lives. All through Scripture, divine encounters redefined destinies, birthed divine moments and delivered breakthroughs — transforming the lives of men. These heavenly visitations are still God's way of transforming our lives today.

In this powerful message, "The Transforming Power of Encounters," Pastor Tara emphasizes how encounters from God are to be held onto, acted upon, and allowed to reshape the pictures and conversations of our hearts to birth undeniable results. He further explains four types of divine encounters that lift us into new realms of breakthroughs. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed
title: The Transforming Power of Encounters

text:
Consistent triumphs in life come when we handle our affairs with spiritual wisdom and power. When we engage life with the power of God, we are empowered to rise to greatness, silence oppositions, surmount challenges and walk in the fullness of our God-given destinies. 

In this powerful message, "The Hands of Prophetic Triumph," Pastor Tara unveils how the lifted hands of the prophet, our fighting hands as princes and our stable hands under the anointed must all align for us to experience victory and position ourselves for unstoppable advancement on earth. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: The Hands of Prophetic Triumphs B.mp3
title: The Hands of Prophetic Triumphs B

text:
The outpouring of the Holy Spirit was Jesus' promise to His disciples — and by extension, to us. This Holy Spirit is our divine advantage in life. 

In this powerful message, "The Outpouring of the Spirit," Pastor Tara emphasizes how speaking in tongues - a gift of the Spirit - is our gateway into accessing all God has provided for us. He also takes us through how the outpouring of the Holy Spirit causes us to experience spiritual growth, the power of God and supernatural prosperity in every area of our lives.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: The Outpouring of the Spirit

text:
A believer's life is destined to be perpetually filled with triumphs and victories. To experience these victories vitally, however, encounters must come to open our hearts to the possibilities of God and to give us big pictures for  life and destiny.

In this lifting message, "Triumphing by Encounters," Pastor Tara expounds on the catalysts to the fulfillment of the encounters God brings to us. He reveals how the study of God's word, speaking, and supplication aid us in meditating on our encounters and maximising them.

Download. Listen. Share. Be Transformed
title: Triumphing by Encounters 2

text:
God has provided everything we need for an abundant life in Christ Jesus. However, stepping into this reality requires allowing God's grace to push us beyond limits into new and higher levels of accomplishments. 

In the first part of this deeply instructional message, "Breaking into Higher Phases of Accomplishments," Pastor Tara reveals how enlarging our hearts — by expanding our vision, structures, and capacity — positions us for greater accomplishments in life. He shows how giving to God's kingdom, receiving divine revelation and encounters are key to increasing our capacity, unlocking new levels, and enjoying all that God has made available to us.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: Breaking into Higher Phases of Accomplishments.mp3
title: Breaking into Higher Phases of Accomplishments

text:
God has provided everything we need for an abundant life in Christ Jesus. However, stepping into this reality requires allowing God's grace to push us beyond limits into new and higher levels of accomplishments. 

In the second part of this deeply instructional message, "Breaking into Higher Phases of Accomplishments," Pastor Tara reveals the important role that wisdom plays in accomplishing great things and also teaches three ways to access it. He also unveils how the favour of God positions us to experience even greater accomplishments.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: Breaking into Higher Phases of Accomplishments 2.mp3
title: Breaking into Higher Phases of Accomplishments 2

text:
Our ability to insist on the promises of God until we see them manifest, many times, relies on how much strength we have, through our interactions with God's word and in prayers. This, many times, determines the extent to which we see God's transformative power at work consciously and replicatively in our lives.

In this message, 'Energized for Destiny Breakthroughs', Pastor Tara Akinkuade reveals how God, in His mercy has designed a system that ensures destiny breakthroughs are continually birthed for us regardless of our current level of strength.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Energized for Destiny Breakthroughs

text:
A believer's life is destined to be perpetually filled with triumphs and victories. To experience these victories vitally, however, encounters must come to open our hearts to the possibilities of God and to give us big pictures for life and destiny.

In the third part of this message, "Triumphing by Encounters,"Pastor Tara shares how miracles birthed from divine encounters are meant to multiply in our lives. He shows us how giving God thanks, boldly sharing our testimonies, and staying rooted in God's Word are key to retaining and multiplying the miracles we enjoy from encounters.

Listen. Share. Be transformed.
title: Triumphing by Encounters 3B

text:
Great accomplishments come by the Spirit of God. It is not by our human efforts or strength that we accomplish giant strides and fulfill assignments of destiny, but by the Spirit who empowers us to rise, prevail, and dominate. 

In this first part of the powerful message, "Prevailing by the Spirit," Pastor Tara unveils how the Spirit of God is our divine advantage for triumph in life. He explains how the Spirit propels us to take great leaps and provides wisdom and understanding that enable us to solve hard problems and have lasting significance on earth.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Prevailing by the Spirit B

text:
Great accomplishments come by the Spirit of God. It is not by our human efforts or strength that we accomplish giant strides and fulfill assignments of destiny, but by the Spirit who empowers us to rise, prevail, and dominate. 

In this second part of the powerful message, "Prevailing by the Spirit," Pastor Tara unveils how the Spirit directs our decisions and causes us to take bold steps. He also shows how the Holy Spirit provides insight and keeps us aligned with God's will for triumph in our lives. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Prevailing by the Spirit 2B

text:
Mount Zion is the prophetic representation of the Church in the Bible. Therefore, every blessing God commanded on Mount Zion in the Old Testament is available to us as believers today.

In this powerful message, "The Blessings of Mount Zion," Pastor Tara reveals three key blessings God declared over Mount Zion that we now enjoy through redemption. These blessings empower us to experience breakthroughs and advancement in every area of our lives. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: The Blessings of Mount Zion

text:
God's will for us is undeniable prosperity. According to Psalm 24:1, the earth and all its increase belong to Him — and by inheritance, to us. However, to experience this increase vitally, there are infrastructures we must intentionally put in place. 

In this power-packed message, "Rising into Gates of Increase," Pastor Tara emphasizes God's unrepentant will of prosperity for us and further teaches three non-negotiable infrastructures we must set up to access and sustain supernatural increase.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Rising into Gates of Increase

text:
Making giant accomplishments come by the Spirit of God. It is not by our human efforts or strength that we accomplish giant strides and fulfill assignments of destiny, but by the Spirit of God within us who empowers us to rise, and achieve great success.

In this lifting message, "Rising with Spiritual Strength," Pastor Tara reveals five pathways through which we rise and birth undeniable results on Earth. These pathways -- the revelation of God's nature, a compelling vision, supplication, encouragement and sacrifices -- are the believer's empowerment kit for a life of sweatless triumph. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Rising with Spiritual Strength

text:
No matter how chaotic the world gets, one thing that remains unshakable is God's will for us to prosper. This prosperity is given to us so that the gospel can spread, humanity can be helped, and we can enjoy the fullness of God's goodness.

In this highly prophetic message, "Prospering to Build," Pastor Tara reveals how true wealth is accessed by the help of God and how He uses divine channels — the anointed, strategic people He places in our paths, and the work of our hands — to transfer the riches of the earth into our lives for kingdom purpose and lasting impact.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Prospering to Build

text:
The conversations within our hearts speak loudly in the realm of the spirit, and God responds to us according to them. Therefore, cultivating the right heart posture is essential in experiencing greatness powered by God.

In this prophetic message, "The Heart of Greatness," Pastor Tara reveals three essential heart postures we must cultivate for God to endue us with greatness. He explains how embodying integrity, embracing responsibility, and maintaining a heart free from offence bring honour, ownership, and stirs us to pray — reshaping the atmosphere to work in our favour.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: The Heart of Greatness B

text:
Everything God places in our hearts carries the seed of greatness. Therefore, no matter where we are today, there is always a higher level we can rise to. This advancement is only possible when we stretch the boundaries of our success through the power of God.

In this powerful message, "Stretching the Tentacles of Success," Pastor Tara teaches how we can step into greater dimensions of success through impartation and spiritual practices, as well as receiving the strategic help of men, thereby causing us to experience all that God has prepared for us.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed
title: Stretching the Tentacles of Success

text:
Desire is God's built-in system for us to accomplish great things and live purposeful lives on earth. It is a force that positions us to receive from God and walk in the fullness of His plans for us.

In this transformative message, "Desire: The Key to Accomplishment," Pastor Tara unveils the power of desire as the starting point for every great manifestation. He teaches three spiritual processes that move our desires from being intangible to tangible realities, showing us how to align our hearts with God's purpose and step boldly into accomplishment.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Desire; The Key to Accomplishment

text:
Regardless of the challenges that may be before us, our absolute trust is in God. This trust and confidence in His divine guidance shelters us and leads us out of challenges into victory. 

In this powerful message, "Portals of Divine Guidance," Pastor Tara unveils how God's guidance is our surety in difficult times. He shows us four doorways through which God's guidance comes and how responding rightly to them positions us for victory and advancement in life. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Portals of Divine Guidance

text:
The man in Christ has been redeemed from a life of unpredictability and uncertainties. By redemption, he has been given the authority and spiritual power to turn situations around, ensuring that life works in his favour perpetually.

In this liberating message, "Prevailing Over Uncertainties," Pastor Tara emphasises the need to wield the spiritual power God has bestowed on us to control and rise above life's uncertainties. He reveals how prayer, giving and staying under a prophetic covering empower us to prevail and record undeniable success.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Prevailing over Uncertainties

text:
Sometimes we face challenges that feel overwhelming and impossible to overcome. A key to overcoming such obstacles is earnest, heartfelt, and continuous prayer. In prayer, we release divine power to crush daunting situations and shift events in our favour. 

In this powerful message, "Victory Over Daunting Situations," Pastor Tara shows how prayer releases power that opens our eyes to see God's possibilities, stirs us up to gather knowledge and understanding for the situations before us, and empowers us to deploy God's power strategically until we walk in undeniable victory.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Victory Over Daunting Situations

text:
Taking territories and rising in life come by divine inheritance. The land God has given to us cannot be claimed by human strength, effort, skill or brilliance alone because oppositions and resistances need to be subdued. 

In this faith-stirring message, "Possessing the Land," Pastor Tara teaches how to take possession of lands through the boldness of righteousness, the bulwark of prayer, and the breath of the prophet. He shows us how, through courage, consistent prayer, and prophetic declarations, we subdue obstacles and possess the lands that God has given us. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Possessing the Land

text:
Every believer is called to walk in greatness and to take territories for God's kingdom through great acts. However, we must learn how to command these acts to cause situations to align in our favour and cities to fall into our hands. 

In this powerful message, "Commanding Great Acts," Pastor Tara unveils the place of walking in wisdom, leading courageously and having a conscious understanding of success in commanding great results. He teaches how these three principles position us to rise in authority, take territories, shape outcomes, and manifest undeniable proofs of God's power in every area of our lives.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Commanding Great Acts

text:
God is eternally good, and His goodness is revealed in how He continually works miracles in our lives. But God does not just want us to receive miracles; He desires that we grow from being recipients of His goodness to becoming vessels through which His power flows. 

In this powerful message, "From Candidates of Miracles to Carriers of Graces," Pastor Tara unfolds three stages through which we move in divine operation — from being candidates of miracles, where we receive God's supernatural intervention; to becoming causative agents, where our declarations birth miracles; and ultimately to becoming carriers of graces, where we command the miraculous and begin to release healing, lifting, and transformation to others.

Listen. Share. Be transformed.
audio_filename: From Candidates of Miracles to Carriers of Graces.mp3
title: From Candidates of Miracles to Carriers of Graces

text:
In Christ, we are destined for greatness and prosperity, and it is God's will that we keep increasing without end. However, for this increase to find expression, we must understand the systems to put in place and trust God to bless them. 

In this powerful message, "Prophetic Systems of Supernatural Increase," Pastor Tara unveils three vital systems by which we can harness the God-kind of increase: our source in Christ, the release of God's power, and the systems of study and strength.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Prophetic Systems of Supernatural Increase

text:
Restoration is God's supernatural way of bringing back what was lost and making it far greater than it ever was. Just as God restored Job's life with double abundance, God is still in the business of restoring wasted years, lost opportunities, relationships, wealth, and influence.

In this life-changing message, "Restoration of Fortune," Pastor Tara shows how God responds when we cry out to Him in heartfelt supplication, and how He begins the process of restoration through three transformative phases that usher us into seasons of multiplied goodness and divine compensation.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Restoration of Fortune

text:
The glory of Jesus is something that we learn of, receive, experience, and grow into. As we behold Christ, His glory rubs off on our lives, reshaping our identity, capacity, and destiny. 

In this powerful message, "Receiving of Christ's Glory," Pastor Tara unveils three divine expressions of Christ's glory — miracles, transfiguration and resurrection — that we are called to receive. As we lay hold on these three, we break into the supernatural, rising not only to do great things but to become all we were purposed to be.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Receiving of Christ's Glory

text:
True and lasting elevation in life is not produced solely by human effort — it comes by the hand of God. When we understand this truth and approach elevation spiritually, we rise effortlessly into the greatness God has prepared for us.

In this transformative message, "Rising to the Top", Pastor Tara unveils how God supernaturally lifts us beyond limitations and ushers us into new levels of influence and impact. Through divine repositioning, divine realignment and divine reenergizing, God places us in strategic places and empowers us to keep up spiritual practices — thanksgiving, prayer and giving — that cause us to advance steadily. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Rising to the Top

text:
After the resurrection of  Jesus, the book of Mark records three distinct appearances He made. Each appearance carries a profound lesson with the power to lift us, transform us, and position us for higher realms in life. 

In this Four Sundays of Glory message, "Rising by His Appearance," Pastor Tara explains how the three distinct appearances of Jesus to Mary Magdalene, the two men on the road to Emmaus, and the disciples represents a dimension of our lifting into glory through deliverance, spiritual illumination, and deeper understanding of God's workings.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Rising by His Appearance

text:
In our journey of faith, we will face moments where the situation before us is completely beyond human ability. In these moments, our response must be to anchor our hearts in God, who specialises in the impossible, drawing encouragement from the testimonies of those whose lives have been transformed by God's mighty power.

In this Four Sundays of Glory Service message, "Miracles Beyond Human Possibilities," Pastor Tara shares several mind-blowing encounters and testimonies to strengthen our faith. He affirms that God is ever-committed to transforming our lives and speaks the powerful declarations that trigger this transformation.

Listen. Share. Be transformed.
title: PastorTaraAkinkuade–MiraclesBeyondHumanPossibilities

text:
The blessing of God is the power for exploits. The strength and capacity we need to do great things in life do not come from our effort but from understanding and walking in this blessing.

In this Testimony, Prophetic, and Communion Service message, "Faith in the Blessing," Pastor Tara teaches how we can actively express faith in God's blessing to see it manifest in our everyday lives. 

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
title: Faith in the Blessing

text:
All through the Bible, we see God begin the journey of men with blessings — without demands or conditions — just as He did for Adam and Abraham. Understanding this truth strengthens us and positions us to enjoy the goodness of wherever we occupy. 

In this Answers From Heaven message, "Eating the Good of the Land," Pastor Tara shows us how God empowers us to walk confidently into the abundance prepared for us and enjoy the goodness of wherever we occupy.

Listen. Share. Be Transformed.
audio_filename: Eating the Good of the Land.mp3
